newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total sees increased role for upstream.
newsitem.headline: Total sees increased role for upstream.

text.p: French energy group Total SA said it expected an increased role for upstream activities in its portfolio at the expense of downstream marketing and refining, while chemical activities would remain unchanged.
Upstream activities cover oil and gas exploration and prodution.

Chairman Thierry Desmarest told a news conference that in the year 2000, upstream would represent 48 percent of capital invested -- of a total of more than 100 billion francs -- with 30 percent for downstream and 22 percent for chemicals.
In 1995, upstream had a 38 percent stake of a total invested capital of 78 billion francs. In 1996, the percentage increased to 41 percent.
Desmarest said that of planned "record high" investments of 18 billion francs in 1997, upstream would get 61 percent, downstream 24 percent and chemicals 15 percent.
